Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Max 5 segments; group the rest into “Other” (always last, dataviz/neutral).
Segments start at 12 o’clock and go clockwise, largest first.
Legend with values always present — angles are hard to read.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.

Definition
Purpose
Part-to-whole with up to 5 segments; the centre always carries the total or key value. Progress = one value on a track.
Encoding
angle ← share · colour ← category (ordered) · centre ← total
Interaction
Hover / tap a segment or legend row highlights it.
Accessibility
Reads as a list of shares that add to 100%; table view.
